text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, she's fast! Especially on that final 
stretch... Her burst was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So this is the "Illustrious Clan," huh. 
They're really something... or should I 
say, truly marvelous...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"'Scion of the "Illustrious Clan", onto 
the glorious royal road'... Alright, 
that's the headline decided!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby made a sensational debut. 
However, there was no time to restâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'll head to the press conference as soon 
as I've changed. Please proceed with the 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
—It may be a bit early, but some already 
view Daiichi Ruby as the top favorite for 
the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Having watched today's race, I, too, felt 
something stirring within me, if you'll 
forgive my saying so.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"I know you will show me the brilliance 
Mother left behind... no, something far 
greater!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
You're right! After running through the 
Tiara route, I want her to run in 
wonderful races like the Arima Kinen and 
Takarazuka Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Excited voices showered the newly debuted 
Umamusume with high expectations, one 
after another. And to all of them, she—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, I will show you a 
performance worthy of everyone's 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
While I am truly grateful for the 
expectations placed upon me, I have never 
once considered them a burden—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This, too, was second nature to her. As 
long as this situation isn't a burden to 
her—
choice_data_list:
(I want to take on a challenge for my 
target race!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her debut race reaffirmed Daiichi 
Ruby's true capabilities. At this rate, 
she should easily be able to win a 
Junior-class GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—No. I would like to focus on my training 
for the rest of the year.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned before, our primary 
objective is the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, shouldn't we tailor 
our training so that you can peak right 
around then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What you seek is not the amount of 
radiance, but its magnitude...? Is that 
it? But surely entering races and gaining 
experience is an option, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I understand what you are trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, entering a race after 
consulting each other is also a 
possibility."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, as it stands, we cannot say her 
body is fully conditioned. Therefore, I 
would prefer our policy to strictly center 
around training."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there is no room for debate. 
Building up her physique properly was 
something I had in mind as well. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Assuming we focus on training for the rest 
of the year, I propose the Fillies' Revue 
as our target race for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fillies' Revue... It's a GII race that 
serves as the trial race for the first leg 
of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next target race was decided: 
the Classic-class Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hello. Ruby, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who walked in was K.S.Miracle... 
Daiichi Ruby's roommate, a girl with an 
ephemeral, gentle aura.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. There are packages for Ruby. And a 
whole lot of them, too!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're not surprised...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I anticipated as much. I will have my 
butler confirm it later."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't ask "from who" or "what" it 
is. Perhaps she assumed it was a gift like 
the flowers delivered to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So, what did you need from me?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That was what I had to do.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Did you come all this way just to tell 
me that?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought it'd be better to let you 
know soon. It might be something you've 
been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... maybe I went a little overboard? 
Haha...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: We're done talking, so it's alright!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, well that's a relief then.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then... should we head back?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be heading back to the dorms.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best again starting tomorrow!

Let's do our best again starting tomorrow, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We settled on the Fillies' Revue as our 
goal, but she was so sharp there was 
nothing left for me to help with. As her 
Trainer, I felt a little powerless...
